targeted_cases.question: Return only the titles of the seven earliest aired episodes, ordered by air date ascending.
targeted_cases.gold_sql: SELECT title FROM episodes ORDER BY air_date ASC LIMIT 7

targeted_cases.question: How many left-handed batters are in the players table?
targeted_cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM players WHERE bats = 'L'

targeted_cases.question: Count episodes by season, keeping seasons with at least 12 episodes. Return season and count, ordered by season ascending.
targeted_cases.gold_sql: SELECT season, COUNT(*) FROM episodes GROUP BY season HAVING COUNT(*) >= 12 ORDER BY season ASC

targeted_cases.question: For schools in Springfield, return school name and district name, ordered by school name alphabetically.
targeted_cases.gold_sql: SELECT schools.name, districts.name FROM schools JOIN districts ON schools.district_id = districts.id WHERE schools.city = 'Springfield' ORDER BY schools.name ASC

targeted_cases.question: For performances from 1998 through 2000, return year and total home runs, grouped by year, highest total first.
targeted_cases.gold_sql: SELECT year, SUM(HR) FROM performances WHERE year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000 GROUP BY year ORDER BY SUM(HR) DESC, year ASC

targeted_cases.question: List the season number of, and title of, the first episode of every season.
targeted_cases.gold_sql: SELECT season, title FROM episodes WHERE episode_in_season = 1

targeted_cases.question: Find the title of the holiday episode that aired on December 31st, 2004.
targeted_cases.gold_sql: SELECT title FROM episodes WHERE air_date = '2004-12-31'

Set stock to 9 for the inventory row whose id is 2.
